title: DigiCert Partner Data Leak
summary: Please be advised that one of our partners, DigiCert, recently experienced a security event on their independent systems. This incident is strictly isolated to DigiCert's environment and does not impact any Akamai systems or customer data. No Akamai platform has been affected in any way by this incident and Akamai system and services remain completely secure.
